claims: SpaceX successfully launched a Falcon 9 rocket carrying 29 Starlink V2 Mini satellites from Space Launch Complex 40 (SLC-40), Cape Canaveral Space Force Station, Florida, on Sunday, March 22, 2026, at 10:47 a.m. EDT.
The first-stage booster landed on the drone ship "A Shortfall of Gravitas" in the Atlantic Ocean.
China (CASC) has a Long March 2D scheduled for a payload launch from Jiuquan Satellite Launch Center on March 23, 2026, at 04:00 UTC.
Norway (Isar Aerospace) has a Spectrum rocket scheduled to launch from Andøya Rocket Range on March 23, 2026, at 13:00 UTC.
SpaceX has another Starlink mission (Group 17-17) scheduled from Vandenberg SFB, California, on Tuesday, March 24, 2026, at 4:03 PM.
